newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian ATX ends at record high, more upside seen.
newsitem.headline: Austrian ATX ends at record high, more upside seen.

text.p: Austria's ATX index advanced 3.15 percent, breaking through technical resistancee at 1,440, to end at record high and dealers were optimistic that the strength would persist into next week.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips jumped 3.15 percent to 1,452.78. Among its constituents 18 shares rose, two fell and one remained unchanged.
"The way is now free. Reaching 1,500 points next week is not a problem," said one trader.
Traders said market participants were cautious and wanted to secure their positions but continued to sit on their long positions.
"You're not getting anything on the index market," said one trader, noting that the market was also boosted by volatility.
"The rise was driven by strong buying interest on the part of international investors," another trader said.
Oil and chemicals group OMV, led the gainers, climbing 5.07 percent to 1,740 schillings.
Bank Austria preferred shares also made strong gains, rising 21 schillings to 436 on turnover of 182,719 lots after Salomon Brothers upgraded its recommendation to a "strong buy" from "buy".
The day's leading decliner was luxury hosiery maker Wolford, dropping 2.32 percent to end at 1,220 schillings.
The August ATX future gained 53 points to 1,469.
